##: Installs by unpacking the NSIS installer rather than running it, so the app is
self-contained under the Scoop app dir and `scoop uninstall` is a clean directory
electron-builder wraps the whole app as $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z inside the NSIS
installer, and that holds for assisted (nsis.oneClick: false) builds too — the
payload layout is an electron-builder detail, not a one-click one. So it is two
extractions: installer -> app-64.7z -> app. Verified end to end on a clean machine:
`scoop install sift` yields a `sift` shim, a Start Menu shortcut, and a launching app.
Sift keeps its library and settings in %APPDATA%/Sift, outside the Scoop dir, so
description: Turns any video into a searchable, transcribed, summarized library — 100% local.
